rows.statement: ANMDMR is Romania’s competent authority and national contact point for interventional medicinal-product clinical trials.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “Se desemnează ... ANMDMR ... ca autoritate competentă”

rows.statement: CNBMDM performs ethical analysis and issues opinions for interventional medicinal-product trials.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “să efectueze analiza etică şi să emită avize”

rows.statement: CNBMDM performs ethical review, ANMDMR scientific review, and decisions are transmitted through CTIS.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “analiza etică ... CNBMDM ... analiza ştiinţifică ... ANMDMR ... CTIS”

rows.statement: The clinical-trial application dossier is submitted in Romanian; documents not intended for subjects may also be submitted in English.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “dosar ... în limba română ... nu este destinată subiecţilor ... limba engleză”

rows.statement: Patient consent is mandatory for participation in scientific research.

source.title: Law 46/2003 consolidated print (Ministry of Health copy)

rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “Consimţământul pacientului este obligatoriu ... la cercetarea ştiinţifică”

rows.statement: Patient consent is mandatory to collect, store, or use biological products taken from the patient.

source.title: Law 46/2003 consolidated print (Ministry of Health copy)

rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “Consimţământul pacientului este obligatoriu pentru recoltarea, păstrarea, folosirea tuturor produselor biologice”

rows.statement: A patient may not be photographed or filmed in a medical unit without consent, subject to the stated diagnostic, treatment, and malpractice exception.

source.title: Law 46/2003 consolidated print (Ministry of Health copy)

rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “Pacientul nu poate fi fotografiat sau filmat ... fără consimţământul său”

rows.statement: Patient health information and personal data are confidential, including after death.

source.title: Law 46/2003 consolidated print (Ministry of Health copy)

rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “Toate informaţiile ... sunt confidenţiale chiar şi după decesul acestuia”

rows.statement: Confidential information may be supplied only with the patient’s explicit consent or where the law expressly requires it.

source.title: Law 46/2003 consolidated print (Ministry of Health copy)

rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “numai în cazul în care pacientul îşi dă consimţământul explicit sau dacă legea o cere în mod expres”

rows.statement: CNBMDM performs ethics review of medical-device clinical investigations; ANMDMR performs scientific review.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “Analiza etică se efectuează de către CNBMDM ... Analiza ştiinţifică ... ANMDMR”

rows.statement: Medical-device clinical investigations require a positive CNBMDM ethics opinion, with ANMDMR validation or authorisation depending on device class.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “cu condiţia emiterii de către CNBMDM a unui aviz etic pozitiv”

rows.statement: The person obtaining informed consent must be a physician on the investigation team, trained in the protocol and good clinical practice.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “trebuie să fie medic, membru al echipei de investigaţie, instruit ... protocolul şi buna practică”

rows.statement: The principal investigator must be a specialist physician with more than three years in specialty or a primary physician.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “medic specialist, cu o vechime mai mare de 3 ani ... sau medic primar”

rows.statement: CMR members must preserve patient confidentiality in scientific publications and refer to medicines only by INN.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “respectarea strictă a confidenţialităţii ... numai cu denumirea comună internaţională”

rows.statement: Research on a person able to consent requires ethics approval and express, specific, freely given written consent, with withdrawal information.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “avizat ... comisiile etice ... consimţământul ... consemnat în scris”

rows.statement: Physicians must identify and eliminate actual or potential conflicts of interest that could influence medical decisions.
rows.notes: Agency-hosted copy; consolidated print. “identifica şi ... înlătura orice situaţie reală sau potenţială de conflict de interese”
